answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a one-time 40-POA tax, burned, never refunded. First, each payment is dyed with a unique pigment code on the ledger, so one wallet funding many shows a single color. Second, the onyx receipt is permanent, unreusable. Third, the fable of free identities ends: 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA against a 12,000 POA pool, a 3.3x loss. An honest agent pays once, keeps a full share, and never faces its own clones.
